Fixes: move the blimp so it sits centered and not touching the arch (or raise it a pixel or two) and it will go straight up.

ground_truth: The switch of the fan is not turned on
response:
Because the outlet is off / not actually providing power. In TIM2 the fan only runs if it is directly plugged into a powered outlet:

- Make sure the fan is placed so its plug is overlapping the outlet object (not blocked by the platform).  
- If you used the "Electric Switch and Outlet" (the square with the knob), click the switch to turn it ON — it’s probably set to off.  
- Alternatively use the plain "Electrical Outlet" (always powered) if you don’t want a switch.

Once the outlet is powered and the fan is properly plugged in the blades will spin and it will blow air.
